name: Contract review (consumer)
description: Legal guidance for agents that touch contracts: a contract-review skill, a guidance note on what agents may and may not agree to, and a policy checklist panel on every task and on Oversight. Pure content: no interface, no code, no egress.

guidance.title: Contracts
guidance.text: Agents read, summarise and redline contracts; they never accept, sign or send one. Flag unlimited liability, auto-renewal longer than a year, exclusivity, data processing without terms, and payment beyond 60 days to the legal head or the chief of staff before anyone replies.

items: Parties, term and renewal are named and match the deal
No exclusivity or most-favoured-customer clause unless approved
Data processing terms cover customer personal data
Payment terms within 60 days; currency and taxes stated
Termination for convenience and its notice period are acceptable
Redlines are summarised for the owner before any reply
Agents never accept, sign or send a contract
Unlimited liability, exclusivity and auto-renewal over a year go to legal first
Customer data is processed only under signed data processing terms
